Inspection ID:
INS003925

Finding:
Tank Shell - Electrical Ground Cable (8 Nos) VI-55: Eight electrical ground cables are securely intact.

Recommendation(s):
Tank Shell - Electrical Ground Cable (8 Nos)VI-55: TBRy - To carry out resistance test annually to ensure the effectiveness and monitor during routine inspection. The resistance test result is recommended to be stencilled on tank shell immediately adjacent to the respective grounding lug. The total resistance from tank to earth should not exceed 25 ohms as per API RP 575 Third Edition, Section 8.2.5. To ensure that grounding lug is not painted/coated as per API Standard 650 Twelfth Edition (March 2013), Figure 5.23
